parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Chinese Shanghai region OSS link. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: PreRegionIntersectFeatures
parameters.description: The vehicle features corresponding to the vehicle detection boxes that intersect with each specified region in the previous frame.

parameters.name: RoadRegions
parameters.description: Multiple regions. The format is [RoadRegion\_1, RoadRegion\_2, ..., RoadRegion\_N].

sub_parameters.name: RoadRegion
sub_parameters.description: The X and Y coordinates of the four vertices of an arbitrary quadrilateral, in the format `[x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4]`.
